# crt-ui

> CRT terminal components for Svelte 5 (`@ritsuki.kagerou/crt-ui`): Crt, Typed, Boot, Meter, ScreenFrame, plus Button, Input and Select form controls, a Table, and Dialog, Tabs, Dropdown and Toaster overlays. SSR-safe, themed with `--crt-*` CSS custom properties, reduced-motion aware (also `data-crt-motion="off"` on any ancestor turns animation off by hand). No runtime dependencies.

Svelte 5 only. Components use runes; events are callback props (`ondone`, `onback`, `oncomplete`, `ontick`, `onclick`), not `on:` directives; `ScreenFrame` and `Button` content is a `children` snippet, not a slot; `Input` and `Select` use `bind:value`, `Dialog` uses `bind:open`, `Tabs` uses `bind:value`; `Dialog`, `Tabs` and `Toaster` content is a snippet too (`footer`, `children(active)`). Every component also takes `class`. Colours, timing and geometry are tokens, not props.

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
	import '@ritsuki.kagerou/crt-ui/tokens.css';
	import { Boot, Crt, Meter, ScreenFrame, Typed } from '@ritsuki.kagerou/crt-ui';
	let booted = $state(false);
</script>

{#if !booted}
	<Boot lines={['RK/OS — BIOS 04.71', 'MEMORY CHECK ... OK']} ondone={() => (booted = true)} />
{:else}
	<ScreenFrame title="CAPABILITY MATRIX" code="SECTOR 02/05" onback={() => (booted = false)}>
		<p><Typed text="BACKEND & API" speed={18} /></p>
		<Meter value={1} label="PRIMARY" />
	</ScreenFrame>
{/if}
<Crt />
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
	import { Button, Input, Select } from '@ritsuki.kagerou/crt-ui';
	let callsign = $state('');
	let phosphor = $state('green');
</script>

<form onsubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
	<Input label="Callsign" bind:value={callsign} hint="UP TO 8 CHARACTERS" />
	<Select label="Phosphor" options={['green', 'amber']} bind:value={phosphor} />
	<Button variant="solid" type="submit">TRANSMIT</Button>
</form>
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
	import { Button, Dialog, Dropdown, Tabs, Toaster, toast } from '@ritsuki.kagerou/crt-ui';
	let open = $state(false);
	let tab = $state('status');
</script>

<Button onclick={() => (open = true)}>PURGE</Button>
<Dialog bind:open title="Confirm purge">
	<p>THIS CANNOT BE UNDONE.</p>
	{#snippet footer()}<Button onclick={() => (open = false)}>CANCEL</Button>{/snippet}
</Dialog>

<Tabs bind:value={tab} tabs={[{ id: 'status', label: 'STATUS' }, { id: 'log', label: 'LOG' }]}>
	{#snippet children(active)}<p>{active}</p>{/snippet}
</Tabs>

<Dropdown label="MORE" items={[{ label: 'REBOOT', onselect: () => toast.push('QUEUED') }]} />
<Toaster />
```

## Props

- `Typed`: `text: string` (required), `speed = 12` (ms/char), `delay = 0`, `hold = false` (blinking caret after the line), `oncomplete?: () => void`, `ontick?: (drawn: number) => void`
- `Crt`: `scanlines`, `sweep`, `flicker`, `vignette` (all `boolean = true`), `noise`, `curvature` (`boolean = false`), `position: 'fixed' | 'absolute' = 'fixed'`
- `Meter`: `value: number` (0–1, required), `label = ''`, `muted = false`, `cells = 24`, `delay = 0`, `stagger = 26` (ms between cells)
- `Boot`: `lines: string[]` (required), `ondone: () => void` (required), `unit = ''`, `hint = 'PRESS ANY KEY TO CONTINUE'`, `speed = 9`, `duration = 1100` (progress bar ms), `skippable = true`, `ontick?`
- `Button`: `children: Snippet` (required), `variant: 'outline' | 'solid' = 'outline'`, `href?: string` (renders `<a>`), `type = 'button'`, `disabled = false`, `onclick?`. Other `<button>` attributes pass through.
- `Input`: `label: string` (required, visible), `value = ''` (`bind:value`, string), `hint?`, `error?` (sets `aria-invalid`), `prompt = '>'` (decorative, `''` hides it), `id` (auto via `$props.id()`). Other `<input>` attributes pass through; use text-like types. `class` goes on the wrapper.
- `Select`: `label: string` (required), `options: (string | { value: string; label?: string; disabled?: boolean })[]` (required), `value = ''` (`bind:value`), `placeholder?` (disabled first option while `value` is `''`), `hint?`, `error?`, `id` (auto). Native `<select>`; no `multiple`. The open list is themed where `appearance: base-select` is supported (Chrome/Edge 135+), native elsewhere. Type `SelectOption` is exported.
- `Dialog`: `title: string` (required, also the accessible name), `children: Snippet` (required), `open = false` (`bind:open`), `footer?: Snippet`, `onclose?: () => void`, `dismissable = true` (Escape, backdrop click and close button), `id` (auto). Native `<dialog>` with `showModal()`: focus trap, inert page and focus return come from the platform. Closed in SSR output. Other `<dialog>` attributes pass through.
- `Table`: `columns: { key: string; label: string; align?: 'start' | 'end' }[]` (required), `rows: Record<string, unknown>[]` (required; cells print `row[key]`), `caption?` (visible; names the scroll region), `label?` (accessible name without a caption), `rowHeader?` (column key whose cells are `<th scope="row">`), `empty = 'NO DATA'`, `cell?: Snippet<[row, column]>` for custom cells. Always give it a `caption` or `label`. No sorting or selection. Type `TableColumn` is exported.
- `Tabs`: `tabs: { id: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }[]` (required), `children: Snippet<[activeId: string]>` (required; only the active panel renders), `value` (`bind:value`, defaults to the first enabled tab), `label?` (names the tab list), `id` (auto). Arrow keys, Home and End move and select; disabled tabs are skipped. Type `TabItem` is exported.
- `Dropdown`: `label: string` (required, trigger text), `items: { label: string; href?: string; disabled?: boolean; onselect?: () => void }[]` (required), `onselect?: (item) => void`, `align: 'start' | 'end' = 'start'`, `variant: 'outline' | 'solid' = 'outline'`, `id` (auto). WAI-ARIA menu button: arrows, Home/End, typeahead, Escape returns focus, Tab and outside click close. Type `DropdownItem` is exported.
- `Toaster`: `position: 'bottom-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'top-right' | 'top-left' = 'bottom-right'`, `label = 'Notifications'`. Mount once. Messages come from `toast.push(message, { kind?: 'info' | 'success' | 'error', duration?: number })` (ms; `0` = until dismissed; default 5000, errors `0`), which returns an id; also `toast.dismiss(id)`, `toast.clear()`. Call `toast` only on the client, never during server render. Errors go to an assertive live region, the rest to a polite one; a toast pauses while hovered or focused.
- `ScreenFrame`: `children: Snippet` (required), `title: string` (required), `code = ''`, `hint = '[ESC] BACK'`, `footer = ''`, `onback?: () => void`, `backHref?: string` (renders the back control as `<a href>`), `titleSpeed = 26`, `ontick?`. It does not listen for Escape itself.

## Tokens

Import `tokens.css` once and override on `:root` or any ancestor. Setting `--crt-phos`, `--crt-phos-hot` and `--crt-bar` re-skins everything; the shades below them are derived with `color-mix()` on `:root`.

- Palette: `--crt-bg: #000000`, `--crt-phos: #4ade80`, `--crt-phos-hot: #d5ffe6`, `--crt-bar: #1ee07c`
- Spacing and type: `--crt-space-1` … `--crt-space-5` (0.25rem … 2.2rem), `--crt-text-sm` / `-md` / `-lg`, `--crt-leading` (1.45)
- White phosphor preset: `import '@ritsuki.kagerou/crt-ui/presets/white.css'` after `tokens.css`
- Derived: `--crt-phos-mid` (62% phos), `--crt-phos-dim` (40%), `--crt-phos-faint` (16%), `--crt-rule` (26%), `--crt-glow` (50% bar), `--crt-flicker-ink` (2.5% phos)
- Alert: `--crt-alert: #ff6b5e` (error text and borders on `Input`, `Select` and error toasts)
- Dialog: `--crt-dialog-width: min(34rem, calc(100vw - 2rem))`
- Type: `--crt-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace`, `--crt-display: var(--crt-mono)`, `--crt-tracking: 0.12em`
- Tube (`Crt`): `--crt-z: 90`, `--crt-scanline-gap: 3px`, `--crt-scanline-ink: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.26)`, `--crt-scanline-opacity: 0.6`, `--crt-sweep-height: 42vh`, `--crt-sweep-duration: 7.5s`, `--crt-flicker-duration: 4.2s`, `--crt-vignette-strength: 0.55`, `--crt-tube-glow: 6%`, `--crt-noise-opacity: 0.07`, `--crt-noise-duration: 0.8s`, `--crt-curvature-radius: 2.5rem`, `--crt-curvature-shade: 0.5`
- Caret (`Typed`): `--crt-caret-width: 0.58em`, `--crt-caret-height: 1.02em`, `--crt-caret-blink: 1.06s`
- Cells (`Meter`): `--crt-cell-width: 6px`, `--crt-cell-height: 12px`, `--crt-cell-gap: 2px`
- `ScreenFrame`: `--crt-screen-min-height: 46vh`
